discussion_comments.comment_body:
**[Critical]** Marker stores `effectiveDesired` (desired − reviewed) instead of the full `desired` set — reviewed users are silently lost from the marker

**Failure scenario:** Run 1: classifier outputs desired=[A,B], both requested, marker stores `{"desired":["A","B"]}`. A submits a review; GitHub removes A from requested_reviewers. Run 2: desired=[A,B], reviewed=[A], `effectiveDesired=[B]`. Marker overwritten to `{"desired":["B"]}`. B is manually dismissed. Run 3: desired=[A,B], prevDesired=[B] (wrong — should be [A,B]), current=[A], reviewed=[A,B]. Drift=[B], finalDesired=[]. `toAdd=[]` — A is permanently lost from the reviewer set and never re-requested.

The existing test "persists pre-drift desired in the marker body" uses `reviewed: []`, making `effectiveDesired === desired`, masking the bug.

```suggestion
  const newMarkerBody = `${MARKER} {"desired":${JSON.stringify([...desired].sort())}} -->`;
```

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Critical]** Marker 存储的是 `effectiveDesired`（desired 减去已 review 用户）而非完整的 `desired` 集合——已 review 的用户会从 marker 中静默丢失

**失败场景：** 第 1 次运行：分类器输出 desired=[A,B]，两者都被请求，marker 存储 `{"desired":["A","B"]}`。A 提交了 review；GitHub 将 A 从 requested_reviewers 中移除。第 2 次运行：desired=[A,B]，reviewed=[A]，`effectiveDesired=[B]`。Marker 被覆写为 `{"desired":["B"]}`。B 被手动移除。第 3 次运行：desired=[A,B]，prevDesired=[B]（错误——应该是 [A,B]），current=[A]，reviewed=[A,B]。Drift=[B]，finalDesired=[]。`toAdd=[]` —— A 从 reviewer 集合中永久丢失，永远不会被重新请求。

现有测试 "persists pre-drift desired in the marker body" 使用 `reviewed: []`，使得 `effectiveDesired === desired`，掩盖了该 bug。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_
